show.description_secondary: Separated from his dying mother as a child to save her life, a poor mechanic grows up longing for her while secretly supporting a selfish lover who later humiliates him. Meanwhile, his mother becomes a powerful business tycoon searching for her lost son. When fate reunites them, his true identity is revealed, triggering a rise to power, revenge, and a battle against enemies seeking his supernatural gift.
